description: This Java class defines a custom Button widget for Android that overrides the pointer icon when the button is interacted with. It manages a custom PointerIcon resource and overrides the onResolvePointerIcon method to provide the custom icon.

classes.name: ResourcePointerIconButton
classes.description: A custom Button that provides a custom pointer icon when interacted with, using a resource drawable.

methods.name: ResourcePointerIconButton
methods.description: Constructors matching different parameter sets for creating the custom button.

methods.name: onResolvePointerIcon
methods.description: Overrides the method to return a custom pointer icon loaded from resources.
